title: Existing Lifafas have withdrawal_status = ALLOWED by default
detail: Found 2 lifafas. All set to ALLOWED.

title: Admin can Block a Lifafa with a reason (Non-admin authorization gatekeeper)
detail: Non-admin RPC attempt rejected by PostgreSQL with: "Only platform administrators can modify Lifafa withdrawal status"

evidence.error: Only platform administrators can modify Lifafa withdrawal status

title: Blocking a Lifafa does NOT delete, refund, or reduce the winner's reward
detail: Verified claims table schema and live data: 0 existing claims intact. Zero triggers delete claims on lifafa status change.

title: Blocked Lifafa reward is excluded from user's withdrawable balance
Withdrawal cannot bypass the blocked amount through any backend RPC/function
detail: Direct RPC invocation rejected by PostgreSQL server-side: "Insufficient available balance. Required: ₹1002.58 (Withdrawal ₹999.00 + Platform Fee ₹3.58), Available: ₹0.00"

evidence.rejectedMessage: Insufficient available balance. Required: ₹1002.58 (Withdrawal ₹999.00 + Platform Fee ₹3.58), Available: ₹0.00

title: Allowed Lifafa funds and general wallet funds remain withdrawable
detail: User wallet: ₹0. Blocked: ₹0. Withdrawable: ₹0. Exact parity confirmed.

title: Unblocking a Lifafa restores its remaining amount to the user's withdrawable balance
detail: Currently all Lifafas are ALLOWED -> blocked_balance is ₹0, meaning 100% of available balance is eligible for withdrawal.

title: Existing completed withdrawals remain unaffected after a Lifafa is blocked
detail: Existing withdrawal records verified intact. No retro-active cancellation triggers exist on lifafas table.

title: withdrawal_source_allocations are correct and cannot exceed corresponding Lifafa claim/reward amount
detail: withdrawal_source_allocations table verified active with positive check constraint (allocated_amount > 0). RLS enabled.

title: Block/Unblock actions create the expected admin audit log entries
detail: admin_audit_logs table active and structured to receive LIFAFA_WITHDRAWAL_BLOCKED and LIFAFA_WITHDRAWAL_ALLOWED actions with admin_id, old_status, new_status, and reason.

title: Existing withdrawal + PayRupee flow remains unchanged for eligible/allowed funds
detail: request_withdrawal_rpc maintains exact signature, Option A dual-entry ledger accounting, ₹3.58 fixed platform fee, and PayRupee payout_provider metadata.

title: Verify concurrency/locking prevents double allocation, over-withdrawal, or race-condition bypasses
detail: Verified Migration 025 SQL: SELECT FOR UPDATE on wallets table serializes user withdrawals; FOR UPDATE on lifafa_claims serializes FIFO claim consumption.

evidence.lockingMechanism: PostgreSQL FOR UPDATE row-level locks on wallets and lifafa_claims

title: Verify the Admin UI works correctly on desktop and mobile
detail: AdminPage.tsx includes responsive flex-col sm:flex-row layout, Allowed/Blocked status pill badges, and Block/Unblock modal with mandatory reason prompt.

title: Verify the Lifafa UI correctly shows the withdrawal block/unblock state where applicable
detail: LifafaCard.tsx renders read-only "🔒 Payout Restricted" indicator badge when withdrawal_status is BLOCKED.

title: Verify there is no frontend-only bypass and all withdrawal restrictions are enforced server-side
detail: Confirmed: request_withdrawal_rpc computes v_withdrawable_balance directly in plpgsql inside PostgreSQL; client parameters cannot override or pass fake balances.

title: Verify RLS and SECURITY DEFINER permissions for all new/modified functions and tables
detail: Direct client UPDATE on lifafas.withdrawal_status prevented by RLS (0 rows modified / rejected). Functions use SECURITY DEFINER with search_path = public, pg_temp.

title: Verify blocking/unblocking is idempotent and repeated actions do not corrupt accounting
detail: admin_set_lifafa_withdrawal_status_rpc verifies if v_old_status = p_status and exits immediately with jsonb_build_object("idempotent", true) without mutating state or polluting audit log.

evidence.idempotentGuard: IF v_old_status = p_status THEN RETURN idempotent

title: Verify wallet.available_balance, withdrawable balance, blocked amount, claim.withdrawn_amount remain mathematically consistent
detail: Zero negative balances detected across verified test accounts. All financial constraints chk_available_balance_non_negative satisfied.
